learnings: Safe methods (GET) don't change state; idempotent ones (PUT, DELETE) can be repeated safely.
Choose precise status codes: 201 Created, 204 No Content, 404, 405, 415, 422.
Error responses deserve a consistent JSON body too.
pitfalls: A JSON body may legally be a number or `null`; the old client rejected those.
